proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord + magic_item family
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no magic_item kind. The taxonomy lists magic_item_root as a source atom but types.ts has no MagicItemRecord, no MagicItemMechanics, and no mechanics family to house it. Every existing family (activation, ongoing_effect, on_hit_trigger, anchored_trigger, triggered_reaction) is incompatible with item semantics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you take a Magic action to throw the figurine to a point on the ground within 60 feet of yourself, the figurine becomes a living creature... The creature exists for a duration specific to each figurine. At the end of the duration, the creature reverts to its figurine form... its property can't be used again until a certain amount of time has passed.

proposed_widenings.name: day_cooldown variant of RestResetCadence (or new ItemRechargeKind)
proposed_widenings.justification: Figurine recharge is measured in days (2, 5, 7, 15, 30 days) — not short/long rest. RestResetCadence has no variant for calendar-time recharge. A new closed type (e.g. DayCooldown { days: number }) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 5 days have passed. / Once it has been used, it can't be used again until 2 days have passed.

proposed_widenings.name: charge_pool with day-recharge (Goat of Traveling pattern)
proposed_widenings.justification: Goat of Traveling uses a 24-charge pool where each hour of use costs 1 charge and the pool recharges after 7 days when empty. This is neither use_count (fixed cap + rest reset) nor spell_slot. Needs a charge resource with duration-based consumption and day-count recharge.
proposed_widenings.evidence: It has 24 charges, and each hour or portion thereof it spends in goat form costs 1 charge. When it runs out of charges, it reverts to a figurine and can't be used again until 7 days have passed, when it regains all expended charges.

proposed_widenings.name: multi-variant item (one item slug, several named sub-configurations)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Figurine of Wondrous Power is a single item category with nine distinct named variants (Bronze Griffon, Ebony Fly, Golden Lions, Ivory Goats × 3, Marble Elephant, Obsidian Steed, Onyx Dog, Serpentine Owl, Silver Raven). No surface type models this one-to-many item/variant relationship.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Bronze Griffon (Rare)... Ebony Fly (Rare)... Golden Lions (Rare)... Ivory Goats (Rare)... Obsidian Steed (Very Rare)... Onyx Dog (Rare)... Serpentine Owl (Rare)... Silver Raven (Uncommon).

proposed_widenings.name: create_companion mechanics subgraph
proposed_widenings.justification: The core effect is summoning a named creature that acts as a friendly companion with initiative placement, obeys commands, and reverts on 0 HP or dismissal. The v4 atom create_companion exists but there is no surface mechanics shape that expresses: throw-to-point activation, creature-kind binding, duration-to-revert lifecycle, or companion command semantics.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature is Friendly to you and your allies. It understands your languages, obeys your commands, and takes its turn immediately after you on your Initiative count.

proposed_widenings.name: probabilistic_override (Obsidian Steed 10% disobedience)
proposed_widenings.justification: The Obsidian Steed has a 10% per-use chance to ignore all commands including revert. This is not representable by any existing resolution atom (attack_roll, save_gate, ability_check). It requires a probability-weighted override that bypasses the normal command chain.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The figurine has a 10 percent chance each time you use it to ignore your orders, including a command to revert to figurine form.

notes: Primary blocker is structural: UnitRecord does not include magic_item as a kind. No honest coercion into SpellRecord or ClassFeatureRecord is possible — the item's core loop (throw → creature appears → creature acts → reverts → cooldown) does not map to any spell/class-feature/mastery payload family. Secondary blockers include: day-count recharge cadence (vs rest-based), charge pools with time-based drain, named multi-variant sub-items, and create_companion subgraph mechanics. The Ivory Goat of Traveling is especially novel — its charge pool has both time-rate consumption (1 charge/hour) and a day-count recharge when depleted, which is structurally distinct from anything in the current resource vocabulary. The Goat of Terror's per-turn save_gate aura (Frightened condition, DC 15 Wisdom) would be expressible if the item family existed, using existing save_gate + apply_condition atoms. Similarly the Silver Raven's grant_spell_access (Animal Messenger) and the Onyx Dog's modified stat block (Blindsight) are rider mechanics that existing atoms could cover, but they depend on the item family existing first.
